name: Stardock
desc: Crude docking station to facilitate basic stellar trade and minimal colony access. Ships are made to stay in orbit, and cargo is ferried via light shuttles.

name: Stardock Combat Module
desc: Military combat modules to provide enhanced protection to stardock operations.

name: Worksite
desc: A ship-based mobile worksite, where assigned crew eat, sleep, and work on whatever the task at hand may be.

name: Dusk Blacksite
desc: A research blacksite, presumably where the DRG preforms its most secret projects. Not that anyone would tell you of course. Heavily armed, it should be considered equally dangerous as a starfortress.

name: Internal Affairs
desc: DRG's Internal Affairs Division are tasked with keeping things as quiet as possible when working on sensitive operations. Although that usually entails scenarios like 'long walks out a short airlock' it also includes less notorious action such as maintaining an undercover supply chain to secret bases.

name: Orbital Station - Separatist
desc:
A space station of Separatist design, featuring short ranged but heavy firepower on all sides.

Must be reduced before a bombardment can be attempted.

name: Battlestation - Separatist
desc:
A space station of Separatist design, featuring short ranged but heavy firepower on all sides, and augmented with defense nodes.

Must be reduced before a bombardment can be attempted.

name: Star Fortress - Separatist
desc:
A space station of Separatist design, featuring short ranged but heavy firepower on all sides, and augmented with defense nodes, drones, and a minefield.

Must be reduced before a bombardment can be attempted.
